newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin denies premier might be sacked - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin denies premier might be sacked - Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has denied rumours that he might soon sack Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Thursday.

"The president told me specifically that such suggestions were completely unfounded, and he flatly denied them," Yastrzhembsky said. Earlier this week ousted security chief Alexander Lebed predicted Chernomyrdin would soon be removed.
Western investors view Chernomyrdin as the best guarantor of economic stability in Russia.
The former gas industry boss has insisted his policies will not change although his government is being forced to revise the 1997 budget plans after parliament voted down the draft.
